commitMessage:
Polish: auth pages, buttons, position details, error messages

- Register / reset password pages use the Pantauku logo and a
  normal-case title like the login page
- No more ALL-CAPS buttons; report and replay 'Tampilkan' is a filled
  primary button
- Position details show readable names and values only (no raw keys);
  on phones a two-column table shows the value inline
- Common technical errors ('Failed to fetch', limits, duplicates,
  permissions, expired/disabled, session) are shown in plain language,
  with the original text under 'Detail Lainnya'
